entries.042138460d62e928: To continue and develop its core theater business, the company plans to create an environment where customers can watch films safely and comfortably, and to operate its theater business as the only cinema in the Abeno and Tennoji area, working with large surrounding attraction facilities to create synergies. Because film exhibition, whose revenue is uncertain, requires a strengthened management base to operate on a sustained basis, and because stabilizing the income and expenditure of the real estate leasing business is important, the company says it will work to identify tenants that are highly adaptable to changes in the environment and to reduce building management costs.
